note: Research and data foundations of the public preview, bound to the four scientific layers. Listing a method's paper means the project implements or ingests that method or dataset; it does not mean the project's implementation has passed independent scientific reproduction. Roles: method-source (we implement the method), input-data (we ingest the dataset), reported-record (transcribed management accounting), validation-target (external evidence we compare against, planned or active), regional-context (framing evidence). Status: in-use, method-implemented, reported-record, planned-integration.

layers.1: Reference atlas: what characterises this place under a stated edition or baseline
layers.2: Dated observations and evidence: what was recorded or estimated here during this period
layers.3: Analytical products: how does the record compare, vary or change
layers.4: Evaluated models: can declared inputs explain or predict a target

publications.authors: Lehner, B., Verdin, K., Jarvis, A.
publications.title: New global hydrography derived from spaceborne elevation data
publications.use: HydroSHEDS hydrography underpins the basin geometry, routing topology and the 15 arc-second reduction lattice for every raster-to-basin aggregation in the atlas.

publications.title: Global river hydrography and network routing: baseline data and new approaches (HydroBASINS)
publications.use: Pfafstetter basin hierarchies define the 7,445 level-12 units and the level-7 comparison frame of the trends study.

publications.authors: Linke, S., Lehner, B., Ouellet Dallaire, C., Ariwi, J., Grill, G., Anand, M., Beames, P., Burchard-Levine, V., Maxwell, S., Moidu, H., Tan, F., Thieme, M.
publications.title: Global hydro-environmental sub-basin and river reach characteristics at high spatial resolution (HydroATLAS)
publications.use: The 281 published attribute definitions are the reproduction baseline: independent recipes are re-run against pinned inputs and compared family by family. No attribute has passed that gate yet.

publications.authors: Abatzoglou, J. T., Dobrowski, S. Z., Parks, S. A., Hegewisch, K. C.
publications.title: TerraClimate, a high-resolution global dataset of monthly climate and climatic water balance from 1958-2015
publications.use: Monthly precipitation, evapotranspiration, soil moisture, runoff, snow-water equivalent, deficit index, temperatures and vapour-pressure deficit, area-reduced to basins with the resolution gate. Its water-balance model structure is inherited by every TerraClimate-derived series.

publications.title: ERA5-Land: a state-of-the-art global reanalysis dataset for land surface applications
publications.use: Runoff and mean temperature, withheld at level 12 (1.05 cells per median basin) and analysed at level 7 only, where they show no surviving trend.

publications.authors: Hall, D. K., Riggs, G. A.
publications.title: MODIS/Aqua Snow Cover Daily L3 Global 500m SIN Grid (MYD10A1), version 61
publications.use: Observed snow cover, the one non-modelled series in the record. Withdrawn from trend use: missing months increase across the record and the cause is unresolved.

publications.authors: Scientific Information Center, Interstate Commission for Water Coordination
publications.title: Water Yearbooks of the Aral Sea basin, 2022-2024, section 2 (withdrawals, reservoirs, environmental deliveries)
publications.use: Calendar-year country withdrawals, limits, reservoir inflow/release pairs and Aral/delta deliveries, with row-level citations. Management accounting at reach and country support, not gauges.

publications.title: Nonparametric tests against trend
publications.use: The rank trend test behind every basin verdict; verified against scipy.stats.kendalltau to 1e-9.

publications.title: Estimates of the regression coefficient based on Kendall's tau
publications.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association, 63(324), 1379-1389
publications.use: Median-of-pairwise-slopes magnitude estimate reported beside every verdict; verified against scipy.stats.theilslopes.

publications.authors: Hamed, K. H., Rao, A. R.
publications.title: A modified Mann-Kendall trend test for autocorrelated data
publications.use: Variance inflation for serial persistence, applied by default with the uncorrected verdict retained beside it.

publications.title: Controlling the false discovery rate: a practical and powerful approach to multiple testing
publications.venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society B, 57(1), 289-300
publications.use: Family control within each variable across thousands of simultaneous basin tests; removes every significant basin for five of twelve testable variables.

publications.title: Global-scale evaluation of precipitation datasets for hydrological modelling
publications.use: Evidence that no precipitation product wins everywhere, which sets the project's rule: forcings are tested locally against gauges before any replaces TerraClimate.

publications.authors: Barandun, M., Pohl, E., et al.
publications.title: A snow and glacier hydrological model for large catchments: Naryn River
publications.venue: as cited on the water-flow study; full locator retained there
publications.use: Regional evidence that snow and glacier process fidelity plus gauge evaluation decide Central Asian headwater model skill.

publications.authors: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
publications.title: Guidance on realizing real water savings with crop water productivity interventions
publications.use: Frames why reduced withdrawal is not reduced consumption; governs the water-savings arithmetic the study refuses to over-read.

planned_validation_targets.name: CA-discharge: compiled observed discharge for Central Asian rivers
planned_validation_targets.note: Gauge discharge compilation for the region; the natural held-out target for the Pskem/Chirchik line of models beyond their current station records.

planned_validation_targets.name: riversCentralAsia R package and teaching materials (hydro-solutions)
planned_validation_targets.note: Regional hydrological analysis tooling and data; candidate cross-check for basin aggregation and model workflows.

planned_validation_targets.name: National hydrometeorological station archives
planned_validation_targets.note: The station network record behind the case studies; extending it region-wide is what converts model scores into validation.
